item.title: Class Action Payouts: Surprising Cash You May Be Owed
item.description:
Here’s a fact that surprises most people: you may be owed money right now and have no idea. A class action settlement could be sitting in a database with your name effectively attached to it, waiting for a claim you never filed.

In the last week of June 2026 alone, a wave of new lawsuits and settlements hit companies from Apple to Disney to Volkswagen. Each one represents real dollars for ordinary consumers who simply bought a product or used a service.

item.title: Class Action Settlements You Need to Know About in 2026: Disney, Tinder, and More
item.description:
Did you know that billions of dollars in class action settlement money goes unclaimed every year — simply because people don’t realize they qualify?

Right now, a wave of major class action settlements is hitting the news, and some of the biggest names in corporate America are involved. From Disney’s $50 million payout to Tinder’s $60.5 million age-discrimination settlement, April 2026 is shaping up to be one of the most active months for consumer class action cases in recent memory.
